# Book of Giants Fragment 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 4Q531 frag. 2 (Cave 4) | **Condition:** fragmentary; lamentation preserved in part

---

**10:1** [...] We are doomed [...] because of what we have done [...]

**10:2** [...] The verdict is final [...] recorded permanently in heaven [...]

**10:3** [...] and nobody can undo it [...]

**10:4** [...] The decree of the Most High stands firm [...]

**10:5** [...] and nothing can reverse it [...]

**10:6** [...] There is nowhere for us to run [...] not up in heaven [...]

**10:7** [...] and not down on earth [...]

**10:8** [...] Every path is blocked [...]

**10:9** [...] and the door of mercy is slammed shut [...]

**10:10** [...] right in our faces [...]

**10:11** [...] Our great achievements are over [...] our power has crumbled [...]

**10:12** [...] our glory is gone [...]

**10:13** [...] the might of our arms has been shattered [...]

**10:14** [...] and we cannot face the judgment [...]

**10:15** [...] our sins are too enormous [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Fragment 10 (Lament of the Giants). Source: 4Q531 frag. 2. The PNEUMA translation prioritizes readability and natural modern English, rendering the ancient Aramaic in a way accessible to contemporary readers. Imagery is vivified and syntax restructured for impact while remaining faithful to the underlying meaning. Square brackets indicate genuine gaps in the surviving manuscript fragments from Qumran Cave 4.*
